basis: The foundation's about page says Thomas J. Bata founded it in 1996 and donated the villa to it, and its people page lists a Board of Directors and a Supervisory Board.
The endowment fund page names owner Čestmír Vančura as founder and chairman with an administrative board, and the Brno court register file N 754 holds the Nadační fond Zikmundova vila.
The foundation page says the Christine and Göran Schildt Foundation arranges the tours and programme, and the board page lists its Board of Trustees.

The museum foundation page says the Akseli Gallen-Kallela Museum Foundation, registered in 1958, was established by family members, the Kalevala Society Foundation and the Finnish Cultural Foundation Support Association, and is governed by a Board of Directors.
The foundation page prints the by-laws, which say the founders Marie-Louise and Gunnar Didrichsen established the foundation and a Board of three to seven members administers it.
An archived copy of the Alvar Aalto Foundation's own page presents the foundation, which runs the Muuratsalo Experimental House, with a board of family, company, city, academy and university members.
The art museum's story page says the City of Järvenpää bought the villa in 1998, and a May 2024 city presentation shows the city board deciding the museum project as owner.

governance.parent: Finnish Heritage Agency, under the Ministry of Education and Culture

basis: The organization page says the National Museum of Finland functions as a department of the Finnish Heritage Agency, an agency under the Ministry of Education and Culture, and lists Hvitträsk among its sites.
The foundation page says Maire Gullichsen founded it in 1980 and that it employs three permanent staff, and the board page names the four bodies that appoint its board.
The presentation page says the foundation was created by a decree of 16 February 1994 that recognises it as a public utility body, following the wish of the artists Hans Hartung and Anna-Eva Bergman.
The history page says the Association Alvar Aalto en France, founded in March 2006, was set up to acquire and manage the house.
